notes: Confirmed from the body: it obtains attribute key 0x3b through the default-pointer/value helpers, then bins the resulting value into return values 1–5 at boundaries 0x31, 0x3b, 0x45, 0x4f, and 0x59; absent records return 5. The name accurately describes this behavior. Call sites use it as a category result.

The blank is appropriately left unnamed. The body validates/selects an attribute-record index from x1, obtains a record value, and combines comparisons against 0x41 or 0x44 with x2 bit 0. Callers supply varying selectors and a flag, but their surrounding data flow does not establish the attribute meaning or the intended predicate, so there is not enough evidence for a semantic name.
